purpose: Complete hand-cut, inked button silhouettes and printed surface materials. These replace native CSS border, background and decorative shadow using nine-slice border-image fill; they are not overlays on geometric buttons.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production UI material for Kanab Quest, a French Breton cartoon village game. Create ONE blank horizontal physical button plaque, the complete silhouette and surface, not an icon to place on a button.
Composition: wide landscape image, one centered plaque about 3.5 times wider than tall. Fully transparent outside the plaque, with 5% empty margin. Front view, no perspective or text tilt. No words, lettering, symbols, icons, objects, decorations or small illustrations anywhere.
Contour: deliberately hand-cut irregular paper/sign silhouette, asymmetrically chamfered corners with visible angled cuts, subtly bowed long sides, a couple of broad shallow notches and small outward ink bulges. NOT a geometric rounded rectangle. A thick confident hand-brushed very dark green ink #172923 outline of varying weight, doubled in a few short places like misregistered screenprinting. The bottom edge has an integrated short solid ink offset, following the irregular shape, never a rectangular drop shadow. Corners must have their own strong character. Make the large central zone spacious and quiet for readable HTML labels.
Material: hand-printed 1930s cartoon/linocut quality; sparse very fine ink stipple, slight paper fibres and worn pigment, tactile matte surface. The surface texture belongs to the whole plaque, especially the edges, not isolated decorative strokes. No glossy shine, 3D bevels, gradients, fabric, woodgrain, photographic paper, UI mockup, stacked plates, surrounding frame or background. Bold and simple enough for 44px-high buttons. This will be used as a nine-slice scalable image with fixed corners. All edges remain mostly continuous and roughly parallel for clean slicing.
Main plaque surface: warm light ivory #fff8e7. Outer ink #172923. Very subtle darker fibres on cream. Keep the centre genuinely light for dark HTML text.

processing: Original transparent PNGs retained. Sharp trim (transparent background, threshold 10), resize to 508×156, 2px transparent padding, WebP quality 92 and alphaQuality 100. Final 512×160. CSS source slice 40px with fill; displayed edges normally 14px and smaller on compact mobile controls. No text is baked into artwork; focus rings and interactive labels stay in HTML/CSS.
